description.narrative: The Action aims at protecting the health and improving the living conditions of the population in secondary cities and small villages in Armenia. This will contribute to reducing the gap between the living standards of the population in the City of Yerevan and other regions of Armenia and thus to a sustainable development of the country. In addition, the Action aims to contribute to a sustainable use of the natural resource water and to the protection of the environment.
